control_acceptance.uncertainty: paired graph 95-percent interval; empirical inequality remains mandatory

custody.labels: separate label.json after durable first response
custody.missing_features: separate backend failure; never incorrect-answer labels or substitute probabilities

feature_schema.finite_checks: One to sixteen content tokens, exact text reconstruction, finite nonpositive logprobs, two distinct alternatives.
feature_schema.first_answer_top2_margin: Sorted top1 minus top2 server logprob at the first non-whitespace content token, including malformed text.
feature_schema.mean_token_nll: Negative mean of server logprob for every emitted content token, including whitespace and punctuation; no implicit EOS.

hyperparameters.energy_initialization: native Gibbs Xavier hidden, zero output

nuisance_view.comparator: train-only standardized logistic, zero initialization, same SGD
nuisance_view.format_valid: strict single two-uppercase-letter answer with optional terminal . or !; no graph membership check

frozen_calibration_protocol.scoring_imports: Gibbs and numerical libraries only; no graph, oracle, PCIB or FoVer loader

training_equations.logistic: sigmoid(w dot standardized_x + bias); train only
training_equations.scaling: train mean and population standard deviation; constant scale=1
